course.learn: Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and SCADA monitor or control physical processes such as manufacturing, power, and water. Safety and availability may be more important than rapid change.
course.why: A security action that is routine in office IT—such as rebooting or aggressively scanning—can disrupt physical operations.
course.example: A water-treatment control network is segmented from business IT and changes are tested carefully before deployment.
course.exam: Expect emphasis on safety, availability, segmentation, legacy systems, controlled maintenance, and specialized protocols.

Authorization determines what an authenticated subject is allowed to access or do. Models include DAC, MAC, RBAC, and ABAC.
